skillsOverview.title: Skills
skillsOverview.subtitle: Manage user-level Skills only, with the real "active in" state shown as-is.
skillsOverview.scope: (center library {{centerPath}} and each Agent's user directory). Project-level .skills folders are not scanned. GitHub updates show a preview first and overwrite the center library only after you confirm.
skillsOverview.count: {{total}} user-level Skills · {{github}} GitHub sources can be checked
skillsOverview.noteAll: Center-library Skills are inactive by default: they do not apply to every Agent. Vibe Board has no automatic "generic / exclusive" assignment and never auto-covers Agents installed later. Skills without Agent icons are not active anywhere yet and must be enabled manually from Full management.
skillsOverview.noteAgent: These Skills are currently active in {{name}}; some may also be active in other Agents. This reflects real records, not an exclusive binding. Enabling or removing them is always a manual action in Full management.
skillsOverview.unassignedSummary: {{n}} Skills are not active in any Agent yet.
skillsOverview.empty: No Skills in this category yet. Import from a local folder, Git, or an Agent directory in Full management.
skillsOverview.noGithub: The center library has no GitHub-backed Skills to check. Local, manual, and built-in sources do not support remote update checks.
skillsOverview.syncDialogIntro: Syncing replaces the local copy in the center library with the remote GitHub content.
skillsOverview.syncDialogWarning: If this Skill was modified locally in the center library, those changes will be overwritten by the remote version and cannot be recovered from Vibe Board.

settings.title: Settings

effects.title: Island appearance effect
effects.desc: Pick an appearance effect; it is saved and applied to the desktop island immediately. Idle shows only the icon; while running, only the working Agent name is shown, without task names, quotas, counters, or the gear.
effects.midnightDesc: Opaque black surface, the default look that hugs the screen edge.
effects.frostedGlassDesc: Translucent light glass that blurs and reveals the desktop behind it.
effects.currentOther: The current color theme is "{{name}}", which is neither Midnight black nor Frosted glass. Picking an effect below switches immediately.

island.title: Island
island.desc: Configure the dynamic island appearance and position.

overview.quietAssistantDesc: Hidden while agents run; appears for approvals, questions, failures, and completion notifications.
overview.persistentMonitorDesc: Keeps the island visible while agents run, then returns to a mini island when idle.
overview.customPresetDesc: You changed hide or collapse timing, so the current settings differ from both presets.
overview.coreSwitchesDesc: Presets set visibility and default timing; the controls below fine-tune them.

settings.generalDesc: Basic application behavior and startup preferences.
settings.launchAtLoginDesc: Start Vibe Board when you log in
settings.displayMonitorDesc: Which display to show the island on
settings.smartSuppressionDesc: Suppress non-critical notifications during focus sessions
settings.islandEnabledDesc: Show Vibe Board status, approvals, questions, and completions in the floating island.
settings.islandMonitorSubagentsDesc: Surface subagent activity and completion history in the island.
settings.refreshRateDesc: Fallback polling interval when no live event is available. Event notifications still update immediately.
settings.windowCloseBehaviorDesc: Choose whether the desktop window hides to the system tray or exits Vibe Board.
settings.islandAnimationScaleDesc: Adjust the speed of island open, close, and content motion.
settings.agentActivityDesc: Show subagent activity and history entry points in the detail view
settings.probeFilterDesc: Silence very short background probe sessions, so connection checks and model probes do not play notification sounds.
settings.autoCheckUpdateDesc: When off, new versions are only fetched when you click "Check for Updates"
settings.autoInstallUpdateDesc: When on, Vibe Board checks and downloads updates only after active sessions become idle, then restarts when safe
settings.updateReady: Update {{version}} is ready. Restart to apply it.
settings.updateReadyAuto: Update {{version}} is ready. Vibe Board will restart automatically after a short idle window.
settings.updateReadyWaitingIdle: Update {{version}} is ready. Vibe Board will restart after {{count}} active session(s) become idle.
settings.updateCheckFailed: Unable to reach the update service. Please try again later or download from Releases.
settings.exportDiagnosticsDesc: Generate a privacy-safe diagnostics ZIP (paths and secrets redacted) for troubleshooting
settings.builtWith: Built with Tauri, React, TypeScript, Vite, Framer Motion, Zustand, and i18next
settings.designSystem: Interface design and engineering by Vibe Board contributors
settings.idleTimeoutDesc: How long a ready but inactive session waits before being marked expired. Expired sessions can still remain visible. (0 = never expire automatically)
settings.idleInteractionRoutingDesc: When you have been away, leave approvals, questions, and plan confirmations in the originating terminal instead of expanding the island.
settings.idleInteractionRoutingMinutesDesc: How long system idle time must last before blocking prompts stay in the terminal.
settings.noAccountQuotaProviders: No official account quota readers are available.
settings.usageQueryEnabledDesc: Read official account or CLI token quota in the background for the island header. Third-party API and proxy usage will be configured in a separate module.
settings.usageRefreshTimeout: Usage query timed out. Please refresh again later.
settings.usageAuthStarted: Opened a terminal for authorization. Refresh after login completes.
settings.desktopOnlyHooks: Hook management is available in the desktop app.
settings.pixelCursorDesc: Show animated border dots around the panel
settings.globalShortcutDesc: Keyboard shortcut to toggle island visibility
settings.noSessionsHideDelayDesc: After Hide When No Sessions is enabled, how long the mini island stays before fully hiding.
settings.autoHideNoSessionsDesc: In Persistent Monitor, hide the mini island after all running, waiting, or error sessions end.
settings.idleCompactDwellDesc: How long the compact island stays after all running, waiting, or error sessions end before returning to mini.
settings.escSilenceDurationDesc: Seconds to suppress ordinary notifications and hover wake after ESC.
settings.tipsEnabledDesc: Show rotating tips in the center area when there are no sessions or all sessions are idle.
settings.carouselIntervalDesc: Info carousel rotation interval in collapsed bar
settings.sessionTimeoutDesc: How long expired or completed sessions remain in the list before being hidden.
settings.sideIslandSizeDesc: Size of the vertical strip docked to the left or right edge: {{value}}px. The top style is unchanged.
settings.allowHorizontalDragDesc: When enabled, drag the collapsed island horizontally
settings.islandResetDefaultsDesc: Restore island display, behavior, sounds, shortcuts, and notification settings.
settings.showToolStatusDesc: Prioritize the active read, edit, or command in the collapsed island
settings.logoMeaningTitle: A workboard for people and agents
settings.logoMeaningDesc: The VB mark represents Vibe Board itself: the dark board is an always-at-hand workspace, while the gradient tile represents tasks, status, and ideas in motion.

unmanagedDelete.title: Delete Skill "{{name}}"?
unmanagedDelete.description: This deletes the local Skill directory from the current Agent. It will not be added to the center library and cannot be restored from there.

sharedDelete.managedDescription: This removes {{count}} managed Skill from ~/.agents/skills. Every Agent that reads the shared directory will stop seeing it.
sharedDelete.managedPreserved: The Skill remains in the center library and can be enabled for Agents again later.
sharedDelete.unmanagedDescription: This permanently deletes {{count}} unmanaged Skill from ~/.agents/skills. Every Agent that reads the shared directory is affected.
sharedDelete.unmanagedPermanent: The Skill is not copied to the center library and cannot be restored by Vibe Board. Adopt it instead if you want to keep it.

batchAdoptPack.title: Adopt {{count}} Skill(s)
batchAdoptPack.strategyHint: Batch adoption automatically handles only Skills that can use one default strategy. If a Skill needs you to choose whether to keep the center version, overwrite it, or rename the import, it will be skipped and never overwritten automatically. After the batch finishes, click Adopt on that Skill's card.
batchAdoptPack.complete: Batch adoption complete: {{adopted}} adopted, {{review}} need individual review, {{failed}} failed
batchAdoptPack.individualReviewRequired: These {{count}} Skills need individual review and were skipped: {{names}}. They cannot use the shared batch strategy, usually because their names match center-library Skills but their contents differ. Exit batch management, click Adopt on each card, then choose to keep the center version, overwrite it, import under a new name, or skip.
